First-stage dropper. Shows a fake "Update available" screen, requests VPN consent + install-unknown-apps, then reconstructs an encrypted embedded payload from four raw resources (single-byte XOR keys 0xAA–0xAD) and installs it via PackageInstaller. Also starts a full-route "System Update Sync" VPN that blackholes traffic during install.

Payload (com.titanpihuwijahi.nofohotudivela): SBI-themed WebView card/OTP phishing (card no., expiry, CVV, DOB, CIF, account no., ATM PIN — first card page exfils on every keystroke via a JS bridge), SMS interception/forwarding, remote SEND_SMS and USSD execution per SIM slot, gallery-image exfil to freeimage.host (API key 6d207e02198a847aa98d0a2a901485a5), installed-app inventory. C2 = Firebase RTDB fetched from npoint.io config (api.npoint.io/3e71ff39bfe02fa84499); active DB apptst-1v-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com via key Admin_Card_10. Dex2C-protected (libstub.so, APK-Dex2C 3.1.41, protected 2026-07-04). Note: APKs use malformed ZIP central-directory fields as anti-analysis (apktool/unzip/jarsigner fail; jadx + Python zipfile work).

Dropper pkg: com.hubicipher.gesacosetu.iharalpha
Payload pkg: com.titanpihuwijahi.nofohotudivela
